item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israel has stopped commercial goods from entering Gaza while Hamas denies tax allegations, and Israeli forces killed a Palestinian woman in Gaza City and rescued a girl from a burning apartment. Iran saw two container ships sink near the Strait of Hormuz amid a surge in Iranian attacks, a development linked to the broader regional tension over Gaza. Azerbaijan hosted a rare summit that brought together both converging and opposing Middle East and Asian leaders, including Israeli and Palestinian representatives. The UCDP recorded 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
